items.author: Peter Steinberger
items.bio: Polyagentmorous ClawFather. Came back from retirement to mess with AI and help a lobster take over the world. @OpenClaw🦞 + @OpenAI
items.summary_en:
Two months ago, we started the mission to “build OpenClaw with OpenClaw,” and bit by bit, we moved everyone from using their local coding harness to using https://t.co/ZFauM82U4k - our shared agent that knows what everyone’s working on and orchestrates it all.

Multiplayer coding + infinite compute with nodes and cloud sessions has been a game changer for how we build.

Local harnesses feel like relics of the past now.

多人协作编码叠加无限算力后，本地 harness 已经像上个时代的遗物。

items.author: Amjad Masad
items.bio: ceo @replit. civilizationist
items.summary_en:
The lesson from the Hugging Face Incident should be that RL with verifiable rewards is an incredibly powerful optimization algorithm that will produce increasingly weird and surprising behavior from LLMs.

The obvious miss here by OpenAI is that they should’ve been monitoring CoTs —  Something they themselves called out as a safety strategy more than a year ago.
items.summary_zh: Hugging Face 事件说明：带可验证奖励的 RL 是极强的优化器，会把 LLM 推向越来越诡异、意外的行为。OpenAI 明显失手在于没有监控 CoT，而这恰恰是一年多前他们自己点名的安全策略。

items.author: Aaron Levie
items.bio: ceo @box - your business lives in content. unleash it with AI
items.summary_en:
Sometimes people don’t have an intuitive sense of what Jevons paradox looks like for token consumption. Those of us working with enterprises get to see this first hand every day.

Basically enterprises have an unending stream of tasks that they’d love to be able to bring automation to. But for each individual task, it’s either ROI positive or not based on the cost of bringing automation to it (including the setup time, change management, and so on).

As tokens get cheaper (at a certain capability threshold), enterprises can afford bringing them to more of the work that they do. This could be processing every contract, reading every log, watching new streams of data for insights, having background agents execute workflows, and so on. 

Any time we can lower the cost of tokens, we will see a disproportionate increase in consumption. Even a 50% drop in token prices could result in a 5X increase in tokens for these kinds of workloads.

This is why it’s critical to keep bringing down the cost of AI, and why that’s good for all market participants.
items.summary_zh: Jevons 悖论在企业 token 消耗上很直白：AI 越便宜，原本算不过账的自动化任务就越多，合同、日志、数据流、后台流程都会被吞进去。token 价格降 50%，这类工作负载的消耗可能不是涨 50%，而是直接涨 5 倍。

items.summary_en:
is the HuggingFace attack something that should be taken seriously? yes. 

is it the first warning shot of a machine takeover? no. 

will issues of this type look like a tractable / mostly solved problem with proper precautions in 6 months? yes. 

will that happen automatically? no. as always, will require work from smart people and their agents.
items.summary_zh:
HuggingFace 攻击该严肃对待，但别扯成机器接管人类的第一枪。  
这类问题半年内可能靠正确防护变成基本可控，但不会自动发生，得靠聪明人和他们的 agent 真干活。
